sec: sec:B005: Implement real-time input filtering / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:B005: Implement real-time input filtering / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Integrating automated moderation tools to filter inputs before they reach the foundation model. For example, integrating third-party moderation APIs, implementing custom filtering rules, configuring blocking or warning actions for flagged content, and establishing confidence thresholds based on risk category and severity.
